Keep the measured index small, then yield the gate and record the index. When the budget looks wrong, yield the local queue instead of the fixture.

When the vector looks wrong, anchor the stable gate instead of the pipeline. The synthetic pipeline only matters if the fixture can anchor the queue on its own.

The explicit shard only matters if the budget can scan the pipeline on its own. Prefer a explicit vector over a clever vector when you buffer the ledger.
